parts.label: Fuel Tank
parts.function: Main plastic fuel tank ahead of the cabin (WM Overview Of Fuel Tank Component -1-).

parts.label: Fuel Tank Protective Pan & Straps
parts.function: Underbody protective pan and retaining straps securing the tank (WM -13- / -14-).

parts.label: Fuel Level Sender
parts.function: In-tank fuel level sender with float arm (WM -3-).

parts.label: Fuel Sender Locking Ring
parts.function: Locking ring securing the fuel level sender to the tank (WM -4-).

parts.label: In-Tank Fuel Pump
parts.function: Electric fuel pump in the tank (WM -5-).

parts.label: Carbon Canister & Leak Diagnosis
parts.function: EVAP carbon canister with leakage diagnosis unit (WM -6- / -7-, USA/Canada).

parts.label: Fuel Filler Neck & Cap
parts.function: Filler neck and fuel tank cap (WM -9- / -11-).

parts.label: Tank Vent Line
parts.function: Tank vent line between canister and tank (WM -8-).

parts.label: Fuel Lines to Engine
parts.function: Hard/soft fuel lines from tank toward the engine (WM -16-).
